what: A whole review round's screenshots still needed naming one by one. Even with a directory glob, a round that shared one filename prefix still had to spell out every one of its own files by hand.
rule: Let a glob pattern also match by filename prefix, not only by directory and extension.
fix: Enforcement: job field `contextGlob` now also accepts `dir/prefix*.ext` (still no `**` and no directory wildcards); `validate` echoes the expanded file count per pattern so an unexpectedly empty or huge expansion is visible before dispatch. Documentation: manifest reference.
